notes:
【实验版】改动较大，可能有未发现的问题。不想升级可以点更新卡片上的「稍后再说 / ✕」。
新增「Gemini」朗读引擎：直连 Google Gemini 3.8 Flash / Flash-Lite TTS（官方 Interactions API），免费层即可使用；30 个精选音色、扩展音色库与自建音色，可写语气（speech_metadata.style）。
新增英文界面：在「怎么用」或「阅读样式」里切换 跟随系统 / 中文 / English；英文书的分章（CHAPTER I、Chapter One、Prologue）与系统语音的英文朗读一并改进。
修复：OpenRouter 上的 Gemini 3.8 / 2.5 与 HeyGen 语音请求失败（400）；语气指令改用 OpenRouter 现行写法，Gemini 与 Fish Audio 模型可用。
为 9 月以来上架的新模型补齐说明与音色标注（ElevenLabs v4、MAI-Voice-2.1、Voxtral TTS 3、Qwen3 TTS 等）；Key 无效、地区不可用、当日额度用完会直接说明原因。
notesEn:
[Experimental] Bigger changes; there may be undiscovered issues. To skip it, tap “Later / ✕” on the update card.
New “Gemini” voice engine: connects directly to Google's Gemini 3.8 Flash / Flash-Lite TTS (official Interactions API) and works on the free tier — 30 featured voices, the voice library, your own custom voices, and style control.
New English interface: switch between System / 中文 / English under “How to use” or “Reading style”. English books now split into chapters properly (CHAPTER I, Chapter One, Prologue), and the system voice reads English text in English.
Fixed: Gemini 3.8 / 2.5 and HeyGen voices on OpenRouter failing with 400; delivery instructions now use OpenRouter's current parameter and work for Gemini and Fish Audio models.
Descriptions and voice labels for models released since September (ElevenLabs v4, MAI-Voice-2.1, Voxtral TTS 3, Qwen3 TTS and more); invalid keys, unsupported regions and used-up daily quotas now explain themselves.
